Who We Are

What We Do

Qantas Virtual is a premier virtual airline operating on the Project Flight network. We recreate the authentic Qantas experience, operating scheduled flights with accurate procedures, realistic aircraft configurations, and professional pilot training.

Whether you're a seasoned simmer or new to flight simulation, our community welcomes you. We provide comprehensive training programs, regular group flights, and a supportive environment to develop your virtual aviation skills.
